run_deepcluster_training: run the DeepCluster self-supervised learning algorithm on an image dataset with K-means or PIC clustering
run_parse_args: run the argument parser to configure DeepCluster training parameters like architecture, learning rate, and clustering algorithm
run_train_cnn: run the CNN training loop with pseudo-labels from cluster assignments using SGD optimizer
run_compute_features: run feature extraction on the entire dataset using the CNN model in evaluation mode
run_main: run the main DeepCluster pipeline that alternates between feature extraction, clustering, and supervised training
